name: Repuso
description: Repuso connects Claude to your review monitoring: fetch normalized reviews from 50+ platforms (Google, TripAdvisor, Trustpilot, G2, App Store and more), each with a sentiment label and on-the-fly translation. Ask for AI insights - what customers praise and what to fix - and AI review summaries per profile. Track official rating history, compare against competitor profiles you monitor, tag reviews for your workflows, and manage signed webhooks for new-review and rating-change events. Add profiles by business name or URL right from the chat. Every call runs on your Repuso Monitoring API account - same key, quotas and pricing as the REST API. 10-day free trial, no card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Repuso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Repuso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.repuso.com/public/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Repuso MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repuso lists 19 MCP tools, including add_profile, add_webhook, create_group, delete_webhook, discover_profiles, get_average_rating, get_profile_insights, get_profile_summary, get_rating_distribution, get_rating_history, get_reviews, and get_usage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Repuso?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Repuso in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Repuso requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Repuso is developed by Repuso. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
